title: News reviewed: 11 item(s)
body:
- licensing agreements/commercial.md changed (doc:licensing/agreements/commercial.md): no effect here: No separate work: one render of the licensing files carries it, recorded with the LICENSE.md.tmpl item (proposal 01a1c20c-5389).
- licensing combos.toml changed (doc:licensing/combos.toml): no effect here: No separate work: one render of the licensing files, and the manifest check, carry it, recorded with the LICENSE.md.tmpl item (proposal 01a1c20c-5389).
- licensing contributing.md changed (doc:licensing/contributing.md): no effect here: sylva is closed to contributions (none is open yet), so the contribution terms don't apply to it; any rendered copy is refreshed by the render recorded with the LICENSE.md.tmpl item (proposal 01a1c20c-5389).
- licensing texts/commercial.md changed (doc:licensing/texts/commercial.md): no effect here: No separate work: LICENSES/LicenseRef-Commercial-1.0.txt is refreshed by the render recorded with the LICENSE.md.tmpl item (proposal 01a1c20c-5389).
- licensing texts/open-project-exception.md changed (doc:licensing/texts/open-project-exception.md): no effect here: No separate work: LICENSES/AdditionRef-Open-Project-Exception-1.0.txt is refreshed by the render recorded with the LICENSE.md.tmpl item (proposal 01a1c20c-5389).
- licensing texts/royalty-free.md changed (doc:licensing/texts/royalty-free.md): no effect here: No separate work: LICENSES/LicenseRef-Royalty-Free-1.0.txt is refreshed by the render recorded with the LICENSE.md.tmpl item (proposal 01a1c20c-5389).
- autodyne finished milestones 2 (lanes M2 to lanes M3) (progress:autodyne/milestone:lanes M3): no effect here: sylva doesn't depend on autodyne or use what changed; the milestone touches toolbox stacks, not sylva's code or dependencies.
- Jacquard finished milestone M4 Input bumps (progress:Jacquard/milestone:M4 Input bumps): no effect here: sylva neither uses Jacquard nor is a Nix fleet; nothing here changes.
- parda-2d finished milestone M1 Vertical slice (progress:parda-2d/milestone:M1 Vertical slice): no effect here: parda-2d depends on sylva, not the reverse; its milestone asks nothing of sylva (no open graft from it).
- Tend finished milestones 3 (Estate graph to Control station) (progress:Tend/milestone:Control station): no effect here: A milestone of tend's own work; tend's changes that bind sylva arrive as baseline releases and conduct, reviewed separately.
- vg-paradigms released 2026.10.24 (progress:vg-paradigms/release:2026.10.24): no effect here: Already in sylva's plan: the open todo for baseline release 2026.10.24 (todo 01a19cf5) carries taking it.
